headline: EPF new limit: wage ceiling for PF deduction raised, understand the full math; will take-home pay rise or fall?
summary: India's central government raised the wage limit for employee provident fund deductions from 15,000 rupees to 25,000 rupees. The decision was announced on a Wednesday.
why: The EPF wage ceiling determines how much of an employee's pay is subject to mandatory provident fund contributions, affecting take-home pay and employer costs.
